answer: To resist Sybils, an agent economy routes incoming queries down a river of verifiable cryptographic work, anchoring each agent identity to a wharf of locked capital. Identities must commit to an exponential stake burning trellis: registering $k$ coordinated clones scales required burned stake superlinearly as $O(k^{1.5})$. This non-refundable burn enforces rigorous economic friction, rendering mass automated identity generation mathematically insolvent.
